We need to produce a test class for CollectorContext.combineWithCollector(String, Object). Need to analyze method: it gets collectorMap entry by name, if it's instance of Collector<?> then calls collector.combine(data). So we need to test behavior: when name maps to a Collector, combine is called with data; when not a Collector (null or other object) nothing happens (no exception). Need to mock Collector. Collector is likely an interface generic. Not provided but we can assume it has combine(Object) method. We'll use Mockito to mock Collector and inject into CollectorContext's private map. Since collectorMap is private, we cannot directly set it. But we can use public add method: CollectorContext has add(String, Collector<E>) and add(String, Object). So we can call add(name, collectorMock). That will put into collectorMap. Then call combineWithCollector(name, data). Verify collector.combine called with data.

Also test when name maps to non-Collector object: use add(name, new Object()) or some other type, then combineWithCollector should not throw and not call combine. Since we cannot verify combine call, just ensure no exception.

Also test when name not present: same expectation.

We need to instantiate CollectorContext; constructors: default no-arg and boolean version. Use default.

Setup: beforeEach create new CollectorContext instance.

Potential dependencies: none.

Add imports: org.junit.jupiter.api.*, org.mockito.*, static org.mockito.Mockito.*.

Write tests:

- testCombineWithCollectorWhenCollectorPresent

- testCombineWithCollectorWhenNonCollectorPresent

- testCombineWithCollectorWhenNoEntry

Use generic capture: Collector<Object> collectorMock = mock(Collector.class); but need import of Collector. It's in same package com.networknt.schema. So import com.networknt.schema.Collector; (assuming exists). If not compile, but we assume.

Implement.

Also verify that after combine, collectorMap still contains same collector.

Edge: ensure that combine is called exactly once with given data.

Will also test that if data is null, combine called with null.
